entities.name: Cephalid
entities.description: Anthropomorphic octopus-like creature type, now consolidated into Octopus; on Dominaria a cunning, power-hungry race ruled by an emperor.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: New Capenna family with which Cephalids are primarily associated.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: Plane where Cephalids look more humanoid.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Continent whose surrounding oceans the Dominarian Cephalids inhabit.

entities.name: Mer Empire
entities.description: Empire in which Cephalids were originally a minor race below the merfolk.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Plotted with Aboshan to give Cephalids access to more powerful magic.

entities.name: Aboshan
entities.description: Cephalid emperor whose ploy with Laquatus empowered the Cephalids; his demise left Llawan empress.

entities.name: Llawan
entities.description: Aboshan's estranged wife who became Cephalid empress.

entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: Race that ruled the Mer Empire; Cephalids overthrew their imperial family.
